title: Public Service Broadcasting Day: Commemorating Mahatma Gandhi's Lone All India Radio Address
malayalam_title: പബ്ലിക് സർവീസ് ബ്രോഡ്കാസ്റ്റിംഗ് ദിനം: ഗാന്ധിജിയുടെ റേഡിയോ പ്രഭാഷണം അനുസ്മരിച്ചു
summary: Celebrated on 12 November, Public Service Broadcasting Day marks the historic day in 1947 when Mahatma Gandhi visited the studio of All India Radio, New Delhi, to deliver his only live radio broadcast addressing refugees from Kurukshetra following the partition of India.
key_points: Mahatma Gandhi visited All India Radio on 12 November 1947.
The day was designated as Public Service Broadcasting Day in the year 2000.
Akashvani Thiruvananthapuram re-broadcast the digitized archival recording across Kerala.
Prasar Bharati is India's autonomous public service broadcaster established under the Prasar Bharati Act, 1990.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Public Service Broadcasting Day is celebrated on 12 November in commemoration of which historic event?

options.text: First radio broadcast in India from Bombay in 1927
Mahatma Gandhi's only live address from the All India Radio studio in 1947
Formation of Prasar Bharati Corporation in 1997

psc_potential_question.explanation: Public Service Broadcasting Day is celebrated every year on 12 November to commemorate the only live radio address delivered by Mahatma Gandhi from the All India Radio studios, New Delhi, in 1947.

title: National Education Day: Honoring Maulana Abul Kalam Azad; Kerala NEP Skill Framework Rolled Out
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ ദിനം: മൗലാനാ അബുൽ കലാം ആസാദ് സ്മരണയിൽ ഡിജിറ്റൽ പാഠ്യപദ്ധതി
summary: India celebrated National Education Day on 11 November commemorating the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, independent India's first Education Minister (1947–1958). Kerala Higher Education Council launched advanced AI skill modules across all universities.
key_points: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad spearheaded the founding of IIT Kharagpur (1951), UGC, Sahitya Akademi, and Sangeet Natak Akademi.
Posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1992.
Authored the seminal historical work 'India Wins Freedom'.
National Education Day has been celebrated annually on 11 November since 2008.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the author of the famous freedom movement autobiography 'India Wins Freedom'?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, India's first Education Minister, authored the influential historical book 'India Wins Freedom'.

title: Kerala State Highest Civilian Honors 2026: Kerala Jyothi, Kerala Prabha & Kerala Sree Announced
malayalam_title: 2026-ലെ കേരള പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു: കേരള ജ്യോതി, കേരള പ്രഭ, കേരള ശ്രീ
summary: The Government of Kerala announced the 2026 Kerala State Civilian Awards (instituted on the model of the Padma Awards). Eminent personalities in public service, social science, classical arts, and literature were conferred with Kerala Jyothi, Kerala Prabha, and Kerala Sree honours.
key_points: Kerala Civilian Awards were instituted by the Government of Kerala in 2021 and first awarded in 2022.
Three tiers: Kerala Jyothi (highest, given to 1 person), Kerala Prabha (to 2 persons), and Kerala Sree (to up to 5 persons).
First recipient of the inaugural Kerala Jyothi award was legendary writer M.T. Vasudevan Nair (2022).
Announced annually on the occasion of Kerala Piravi (1 November).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the first recipient of the prestigious 'Kerala Jyothi' award instituted by the Government of Kerala in 2022?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Jnanpith laureate M.T. Vasudevan Nair was conferred the inaugural Kerala Jyothi award in 2022 for his exceptional contributions to literature and cinema.

title: Kerala Piravi Dinam: 70th Anniversary of the Formation of Kerala State (1956–2026)
malayalam_title: കേരളപ്പിറവി 70-ാം വാർഷികം: ഐക്യകേരള രൂപീകരണ നേട്ടം ആഘോഷിച്ചു
summary: Kerala celebrated the historic 70th anniversary of its formation on 1 November 2026. The state of Kerala was formed on 1 November 1956 by merging Travancore-Cochin with the Malabar district of Madras State and the Kasaragod taluk of South Canara under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956.
key_points: The Fazal Ali Commission (States Reorganisation Commission 1953) recommended the linguistic formation of Kerala.
Members of the Commission: Justice Fazal Ali (Chairman), K.M. Panikkar, and H.N. Kunzru.
First Governor of Kerala: Dr. B. Ramakrishna Rao (assumed office 1 November 1956).
First Chief Minister of Kerala: E.M.S. Namboodiripad (ministry formed on 5 April 1957).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the first Governor of Kerala following the formation of the state on 1 November 1956?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Dr. B. Ramakrishna Rao assumed office as the first full Governor of Kerala on 1 November 1956, after P.S. Rao acted as interim head during the merger transition.

title: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas): Honoring Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ ഐക്യ ദിനം: സർദാർ വല്ലഭ്ഭായ് പട്ടേൽ ജന്മദിനം ആഘോഷിച്ചു
summary: India celebrated National Unity Day on 31 October commemorating the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the Iron Man of India who integrated over 560 princely states into the Indian Union.
key_points: Sardar Patel served as the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
Statue of Unity (182 meters), the world's tallest statue, is dedicated to him at Kevadia, Gujarat along the Narmada river.
National Unity Day was instituted in 2014.
Posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1991.

psc_potential_question.question_text: On the banks of which river is the Statue of Unity, dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, situated?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The Statue of Unity (182 meters) is located facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam on the river Narmada in Kevadia, Gujarat.

title: United Nations Day (81st Anniversary) and World Polio Day Celebrated
malayalam_title: ഐക്യരാഷ്ട്രസഭാ ദിനവും ലോക പോളിയോ ദിനവും ആചരിച്ചു
summary: 24 October marks the 81st anniversary of the entry into force of the UN Charter in 1945. Simultaneously, World Polio Day highlighted India's 12 consecutive years as a certified polio-free nation (declared by WHO in March 2014).
key_points: UN Charter was signed on 26 June 1945 in San Francisco and came into effect on 24 October 1945.
India was an original founding member of the United Nations (signing on 26 June 1945).
World Polio Day commemorates the birth of Jonas Salk, developer of the first successful polio vaccine.
Six official languages of the UN: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish.

psc_potential_question.question_text: In which year was India officially declared a 'Polio-Free' country by the World Health Organization (WHO)?
psc_potential_question.explanation: On 27 March 2014, the World Health Organization (WHO) officially declared India and the entire South-East Asia Region free of polio.

title: 157th Gandhi Jayanti & International Day of Non-Violence Observed
malayalam_title: 157-ാമത് ഗാന്ധി ജയന്തിയും അന്താരാഷ്ട്ര അഹിംസാ ദിനവും ആചരിച്ചു
summary: The nation observed the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi and the birth anniversary of India's second Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri. United Nations observed the day as the International Day of Non-Violence.
key_points: Mahatma Gandhi was born on 2 October 1869 in Porbandar, Gujarat.
UN General Assembly unanimously established 2 October as the International Day of Non-Violence in 2007.
Mahatma Gandhi visited Kerala five times: 1920 (Khilafat/Non-Cooperation), 1925 (Vaikom Satyagraha), 1927 (Khadi tour), 1934 (Harijan tour), and 1937 (Temple Entry Proclamation).
Lal Bahadur Shastri gave the famous slogan 'Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan' during the 1965 war.

psc_potential_question.question_text: How many times did Mahatma Gandhi officially visit Kerala during India's freedom struggle?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi visited Kerala a total of 5 times: in August 1920, March 1925 (during Vaikom Satyagraha), October 1927, January 1934, and January 1937.

title: Sree Narayana Guru 98th Samadhi Anniversary Observed Across Kerala
malayalam_title: ശ്രീനാരായണ ഗുരു സമാധി ദിനം കേരളം ഭക്തിസാന്ദ്രമായി ആചരിച്ചു
summary: The 98th Samadhi anniversary of spiritual leader and social reformer Sree Narayana Guru was observed on 21 September (Kanni 5 in Malayalam calendar). Devotees gathered at Sivagiri Mutt, Varkala, where Guru attained Samadhi in 1928.
key_points: Sree Narayana Guru was born on 20 August 1856 at Chempazhanthy, Thiruvananthapuram.
Historic Aruvippuram Shiva Pratishtha was conducted on Shivaratri night in 1888 ('One Caste, One Religion, One God for Man').
Founded the Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana (SNDP) Yogam in 1903; Kumaran Asan was the first General Secretary.
Attained Samadhi at Sivagiri, Varkala on 20 September 1928 (Kanni 5, 1104 ME).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who served as the first General Secretary of the SNDP Yogam founded by Sree Narayana Guru in 1903?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Mahakavi Kumaran Asan was appointed the first General Secretary of the SNDP Yogam in 1903, while Sree Narayana Guru was the permanent President.

title: National Teachers' Day: Kerala State Best Teacher Awards 2026 Conferred
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ അധ്യാപക ദിനത്തിൽ സംസ്ഥാന മികച്ച അധ്യാപക പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ സമ്മാനിച്ചു
summary: Observed on 5 September on the birth anniversary of philosopher, scholar, and India's second President Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan. The General Education Department awarded 40 school teachers for innovations in inclusive digital pedagogy.
key_points: Teachers' Day has been observed in India on 5 September since 1962.
Dr. S. Radhakrishnan was the first Vice President of India (1952–1962) and second President (1962–1967).
First recipient of Bharat Ratna in 1954 alongside C. Rajagopalachari and C.V. Raman.
World Teachers' Day is celebrated internationally on 5 October.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan served as the first Vice President of India. Who was India's first recipient of the Bharat Ratna in 1954 along with him?

options.text: C. Rajagopalachari and Sir C.V. Raman
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Maulana Azad

psc_potential_question.explanation: In 1954, the Bharat Ratna was awarded to three distinguished personalities: C. Rajagopalachari, Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, and Sir C.V. Raman.

title: National Sports Day: Major Dhyan Chand Birth Anniversary Celebrated; Kerala Sports Honors Announced
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ കായിക ദിനം: മേജർ ധ്യാൻചന്ദ് ജന്മദിനത്തിൽ സംസ്ഥാന കായിക പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ
summary: National Sports Day was celebrated on 29 August in memory of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand. In Thiruvananthapuram, the Kerala State Sports Council announced the G.V. Raja Awards and fellowships for emerging athletes in athletics and rowing.
key_points: Major Dhyan Chand (29 August 1905 – 3 December 1979) won three Olympic gold medals in hockey (1928 Amsterdam, 1932 Los Angeles, 1936 Berlin).
Khel Ratna Award was renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in August 2021.
Godavarma Raja (Lt. Col. P.R. Godavarma Raja) is known as the 'Father of Tourism and Modern Sports in Kerala'.
First recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was Viswanathan Anand (1991–92).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the first recipient of India's highest sporting honor, the Khel Ratna Award (1991-92)?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the inaugural recipient of the Khel Ratna Award in 1991–92.

title: 80th Independence Day Celebrated: Prime Minister Addresses Nation from Red Fort
malayalam_title: രാജ്യം 80-ാമത് സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യദിനം ആഘോഷിച്ചു; ചെങ്കോട്ടയിൽ ത്രിവർണ്ണ പതാക ഉയർന്നു
summary: India celebrated its 80th Independence Day on 15 August 2026 with ceremonial flag-hoisting at the ramparts of Red Fort, New Delhi. The address outlined the 2047 Viksit Bharat vision, indigenization in deep tech, and self-reliance in aerospace manufacturing.
key_points: India achieved independence from British colonial rule on 15 August 1947.
Jawaharlal Nehru delivered the historic 'Tryst with Destiny' speech at midnight on 14–15 August 1947.
Pingali Venkayya designed the basic framework of the Indian National Flag.
The National Flag was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 July 1947.

psc_potential_question.question_text: On which date did the Constituent Assembly of India officially adopt the National Flag (Tricolour)?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The National Flag of India was formally adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 July 1947, shortly before India gained independence.

title: International Tiger Day 2026: Periyar Tiger Reserve Named Best Managed Reserve in India
malayalam_title: ലോക കടുവാ ദിനം: പെരിയാർ ടൈഗർ റിസർവിന് ദേശീയ തലത്തിൽ ഒന്നാം സ്ഥാനം
summary: On Global Tiger Day (29 July), the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) released the 2026 Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) ranking Periyar Tiger Reserve in Thekkady as the top-managed tiger reserve in India for eco-development and anti-poaching community engagement.
key_points: Periyar Tiger Reserve was declared a sanctuary in 1950 (initially Nellikkampatty Game Sanctuary, 1934) and brought under Project Tiger in 1978.
Project Tiger was launched by the Government of India in 1973 from Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand.
Periyar river originates from the Sivagiri Hills inside the reserve.
Kerala has two Tiger Reserves: Periyar Tiger Reserve and Parambikulam Tiger Reserve.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which are the two designated Tiger Reserves located in the state of Kerala?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Kerala has two official Tiger Reserves: Periyar Tiger Reserve (Idukki) and Parambikulam Tiger Reserve (Palakkad).

title: 27th Kargil Vijay Diwas: India Commemorates Operation Vijay Victory
malayalam_title: 27-ാമത് കാർഗിൽ വിജയ് ദിവസ്: ധീര സൈനികരെ രാജ്യം അനുസ്മരിച്ചു
summary: The nation observed the 27th anniversary of Kargil Vijay Diwas on 26 July 2026, paying tribute to the brave soldiers who recaptured heights occupied by Pakistani infiltrators during the 1999 Kargil conflict (Operation Vijay).
key_points: Operation Vijay concluded successfully on 26 July 1999.
Param Vir Chakra awardees of Kargil War: Captain Vikram Batra, Lieutenant Manoj Kumar Pandey, Subedar Major Yogendra Singh Yadav, Subedar Sanjay Kumar.
Indian Air Force's complementary operation was code-named 'Operation Safed Sagar'.
Kargil War Memorial is located at Dras, Ladakh.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What was the code name of the Indian Air Force operation launched in support of the Army during the 1999 Kargil conflict?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Operation Safed Sagar was the code name for the Indian Air Force's air strikes supporting ground troops in Operation Vijay during the Kargil War in 1999.

title: Reading Day (Vayanadinam) Celebrated Across Kerala: Honoring P.N. Panicker
malayalam_title: കേരളത്തിൽ വായനാദിനം ആചരിച്ചു; പി.എൻ പണിക്കർ സ്മരണ പുതുക്കി
summary: Kerala observed Reading Day (Vayanadinam) on 19 June, marking the death anniversary of P.N. Panicker, the father of the library movement in Kerala. The week from 19 to 25 June was celebrated as 'Vayanavaram' (Reading Week) in all schools and libraries.
key_points: P.N. Panicker founded the Thiruvithaamkoor Granthasala Sangham (Travancore Library Association) in 1945.
Famous slogan: 'Vayichu Valaruka, Chinthichu Vivikikuka' (Read and Grow, Think and Enlighten).
Kerala Granthasala Sangham was awarded the prestigious 'Krupskaya' literacy award by UNESCO in 1975.
Kerala was the first state in India to achieve complete literacy (declared at Kozhikode on 18 April 1991).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who is revered as the 'Father of the Library Movement in Kerala'?
psc_potential_question.explanation: P.N. Panicker (1909–1995) is revered as the Father of the Library Movement in Kerala. His death anniversary on 19 June is commemorated annually as Reading Day.

title: World Environment Day 2026: Kerala Launches 'Prakrithi Keralam' Afforestation Drive
malayalam_title: ലോക പരിസ്ഥിതി ദിനം: 'പ്രകൃതി കേരളം' ഹരിതവൽക്കരണ പദ്ധതി ആരംഭിച്ചു
summary: On World Environment Day, the Department of Environment and Climate Change launched 'Prakrithi Keralam' planting 1 crore indigenous endemic trees in riparian corridors and degraded Western Ghats slopes.
key_points: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June since 1973 under the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
Marked following the 1972 Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment.
Kerala has a recorded forest cover of over 29.6% of its geographical area.
Haritha Karma Sena celebrated collection of over 50,000 tonnes of non-biodegradable plastic.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Where was the landmark 1972 United Nations Conference on the Human Environment held?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The 1972 Stockholm Conference in Sweden was the UN's first major conference on international environmental issues, leading to the creation of UNEP.

title: 13th Anniversary of Malayalam Classical Language Status Observed Across Kerala
malayalam_title: മലയാളത്തിന് ശ്രേഷ്ഠഭാഷാ പദവി ലഭിച്ചതിന്റെ 13-ാം വാർഷികം ആഘോഷിച്ചു
summary: Cultural forums celebrated the 13th anniversary of Malayalam being officially declared a Classical Language (ശ്രേഷ്ഠഭാഷ) by the Union Cabinet on 23 May 2013.
key_points: Malayalam was the 5th language in India to be recognized as a Classical Language.
Criteria for classical status include high antiquity of early texts over 1,500-2,000 years and original literary tradition.
Other classical languages: Tamil (2004), Sanskrit (2005), Telugu (2008), Kannada (2008), Odia (2014), and Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, Bengali (2024 additions).
Malayalam University (Thunchath Ezhuthachan Malayalam University) was established in 2012 at Tirur, Malappuram.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Where is the headquarters of the Thunchath Ezhuthachan Malayalam University located?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Thunchath Ezhuthachan Malayalam University was inaugurated on 1 November 2012 at Tirur in Malappuram district, the birthplace of Ezhuthachan.

title: National Technology Day 2026: Commemorating Operation Shakti Nuclear Tests
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ സാങ്കേതിക ദിനം: പൊഖ്റാൻ-2 ആണവ പരീക്ഷണങ്ങളുടെ ഓർമ്മ പുതുക്കി
summary: National Technology Day was celebrated on 11 May to commemorate the anniversary of the successful nuclear tests conducted in Pokhran, Rajasthan on 11 May 1998 (Operation Shakti), under the leadership of Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.
key_points: On 11 May 1998, India successfully test-fired five nuclear devices at the Pokhran test range.
Also on 11 May 1998, India test-flew the first indigenous aircraft 'Hansa-3' and test-fired the Trishul missile.
Designated as National Technology Day by Prime Minister Vajpayee in 1999.
First nuclear test (Smiling Buddha) was conducted on 18 May 1974.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What was the official code name of the Pokhran-II nuclear tests conducted by India in May 1998?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Operation Shakti was the code name of the five nuclear tests conducted by India on 11 and 13 May 1998 at Pokhran, Rajasthan.

title: National Panchayati Raj Day: Kerala Local Bodies Sweep National Governance Awards
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ പഞ്ചായത്തിരാജ് ദിനത്തിൽ കേരളത്തിന് മികച്ച പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ
summary: Observed on 24 April to mark the enactment of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, Kerala Panchayats won premier honours in the Deen Dayal Upadhyay Panchayat Sashaktikaran Puraskar for grassroots participatory planning and waste management.
key_points: The 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 came into effect on 24 April 1993.
Added Part IX (Articles 243 to 243-O) and the Eleventh Schedule (29 functional subjects).
Kerala passed the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act in 1994, followed by the historic People’s Plan Campaign (Janakeeya Asoothranam) in 1996.
Kerala was a pioneer in devolution of 35-40% of plan funds directly to local self-governments.

psc_potential_question.question_text: In which year was the historic People's Plan Campaign (ജനകീയാസൂത്രണം) launched in Kerala?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The People’s Plan Campaign was formally launched on 17 August 1996 by the Government of Kerala to ensure decentralized planning through grassroots local bodies.

title: 135th Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti Observed as 'Samata Diwas' Across India
malayalam_title: 135-ാമത് ഡോ. ബി.ആർ അംബേദ്കർ ജയന്തി സമതാ ദിവസ് ആയി ആചരിച്ചു
summary: Nation observed the 135th birth anniversary of the Father of the Indian Constitution, Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar. Ceremonial floral tributes were paid at Parliament House and Deekshabhoomi, Nagpur.
key_points: Dr. Ambedkar was born on 14 April 1891 in Mhow, Central Provinces (now Madhya Pradesh).
Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
First Law and Justice Minister of independent India.
Posthumously conferred the Bharat Ratna in 1990.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was appointed Chairman of the Drafting Committee on 29 August 1947, tasked with preparing the draft of the Constitution.

title: World Water Day: Kerala Water Authority Completes Bharathapuzha Rejuvenation Phase 2
malayalam_title: ലോക ജലദിനം: ഭാരതപ്പുഴ പുനരുജ്ജീവന രണ്ടാം ഘട്ടം പൂർത്തിയായി
summary: On World Water Day (22 March), Kerala Water Authority and the Water Resources Department announced the completion of 12 check dams and sub-surface dykes along the Bharathapuzha basin in Palakkad and Malappuram, restoring summer base-flows.
key_points: Bharathapuzha (also known as Nila) is the second longest river in Kerala (209 km).
Originates from the Anaimalai Hills in Tamil Nadu.
Major tributaries: Kalpathipuzha, Gayathripuzha, Thuthapuzha, and Chitturpuzha.
Empties into the Arabian Sea at Ponnani in Malappuram district.

psc_potential_question.question_text: At which historic coastal town does the Bharathapuzha (Nila) river empty into the Arabian Sea?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The Bharathapuzha drains into the Arabian Sea at Ponnani in Malappuram district.

title: International Women’s Day 2026: State 'Vanitha Ratna' Awards Presented in Thiruvananthapuram
malayalam_title: സംസ്ഥാന വനിതാ രത്ന പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ വിതരണം ചെയ്തു
summary: On International Women’s Day, the Women and Child Development Department conferred the state's highest women honor upon leaders in public health, rural literacy, and environmental activism.
key_points: Theme for 2026 focused on inclusive digital literacy and wage parity.
Kerala has the highest sex ratio in India (1,084 females per 1,000 males as per Census).
Kudumbashree celebrated crossing 46 Lakh active members.
Gender budgeting is integrated into local body annual plans across Kerala.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which district in Kerala was the birthplace of the Kudumbashree Mission launched in May 1998?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Kudumbashree was formally launched on 17 May 1998 at Malappuram by Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

title: National Science Day 2026: VSSC Celebrates Advanced Cryogenic Engine Testing Milestones
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ ശാസ്ത്ര ദിനം: വിക്രം സാരാഭായ് സ്പേസ് സെന്ററിൽ റോക്കറ്റ് എൻജിൻ പ്രദർശനം

title: Padma Awards 2025: Eminent Personalities from Kerala Honored for Literature and Arts
malayalam_title: 2025-ലെ പത്മ പുരസ്കാരങ്ങൾ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു; കേരളത്തിന് അഭിമാന നേട്ടങ്ങൾ
summary: The Government of India announced the prestigious Padma Awards on the eve of the 76th Republic Day. Eminent contributors from Kerala in traditional Kathakali, Malayalam literature, Sanskrit scholarship, and organic agriculture were conferred with Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan honors.
key_points: Padma Awards were instituted in the year 1954.
Three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
Awards do not amount to a title under Article 18(1) of the Indian Constitution (Balaji Raghavan vs Union of India, 1995).
Kerala recipients highlighted achievements in folk arts and tribal medicinal plant preservation.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which landmark Supreme Court judgment ruled that national awards like Bharat Ratna and Padma Awards are not 'titles' under Article 18(1) of the Constitution of India?

options.text: Balaji Raghavan vs Union of India (1995)

psc_potential_question.explanation: In Balaji Raghavan vs Union of India (1995), the Supreme Court held that National Awards do not violate Article 18(1) because they are decorations and not titles.

title: India Crosses 195 GW Renewable Milestone: International Solar Alliance Expands Headquarters
malayalam_title: ഇന്ത്യ പുനരുപയോഗ ഊർജത്തിൽ 195 ജിഗാവാട്ട് നാഴികക്കല്ല് പിന്നിട്ടു
summary: India has cemented its position among the world’s top 3 nations in solar and wind capacity addition, crossing 195 GW of renewable installations toward its 2030 target of 500 GW. The International Solar Alliance (ISA) headquartered in Gurugram launched new solar mini-grid grants.
key_points: India’s target: 500 GW of non-fossil electricity capacity by 2030 as per COP26 Panchamrit pledges.
Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana has surpassed 1.2 crore household solar rooftop registrations.
Kerala’s ANERT achieved 100 MW rooftop solar in Thiruvananthapuram.
International Solar Alliance (ISA) headquarters is situated in Gurugram, Haryana.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Where is the global headquarters of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) located?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The International Solar Alliance (ISA), initiated jointly by India and France in 2015, has its permanent secretariat and headquarters in Gurugram, Haryana, India.

title: National Youth Day 2025: Kerala Youth Commission Announces 'Samagra Yuva' Skill Grants
malayalam_title: ദേശീയ യുവജന ദിനത്തിൽ 'സമഗ്ര യുവ' നൈപുണ്യ ഗ്രാന്റ് പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു
summary: Commemorating the 162nd birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda, celebrated nationally as National Youth Day, the Kerala State Youth Commission launched the 'Samagra Yuva' venture grant to empower rural youth in digital marketing, artificial intelligence, and organic agribusiness.
key_points: Celebrated on 12 January every year since 1985.
Swami Vivekananda represented India at the 1893 Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago.
Kerala Youth Commission was established under the Kerala State Youth Commission Act, 2014.
Grant provides interest-free collateral subsidies up to Rs 2 Lakhs for rural cooperatives.

psc_potential_question.question_text: National Youth Day in India is celebrated on 12 January in honor of whose birth anniversary?
psc_potential_question.explanation: National Youth Day is celebrated on 12 January every year to commemorate the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda (born 12 January 1863).

title: 18th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention Celebrated: NORKA Roots Enhances Welfare Umbrella
malayalam_title: 18-ാമത് പ്രവാസി ഭാരതീയ ദിവസിൽ ആഗോള മലയാളി പവലിയൻ ശ്രദ്ധേയമായി
summary: The 18th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) convention was celebrated to recognize the contributions of the overseas Indian community. The Non-Resident Keralites Affairs department (NORKA Roots) established a special pavilion showcasing Kerala’s 'Care Economy' and overseas student welfare initiatives.
key_points: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas commemorates the return of Mahatma Gandhi from South Africa to Mumbai on 9 January 1915.
Theme for 2025 focused on Diaspora Innovation, Skill Mobility, and Ethical Recruitment.
NORKA Roots announced an enhanced insurance shield of Rs 5 Lakhs for Pravasis returning during emergencies.
Kerala accounts for the highest outward remittance recipient state in India (RBI Study).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is celebrated every year to commemorate which historic event?

options.text: The signing of the Indian Constitution in 1950
Mahatma Gandhi’s return to India from South Africa on 9 January 1915
The launch of the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1920
The establishment of the Ministry of Overseas Indian Affairs

psc_potential_question.explanation: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is observed on 9 January to mark the return of Mahatma Gandhi from South Africa to Mumbai in 1915, leading India’s freedom movement.

title: Kerala Forest Department Unveils First-Ever AI 'Vanavijayam' Wildlife Early-Warning Corridor in Wayanad
malayalam_title: വയനാട്ടിൽ എ.ഐ അധിഷ്ഠിത വന്യജീവി മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് സംവിധാനം 'വനവിജയം' നിലവിൽ വന്നു
summary: In a pioneering step to mitigate Human-Wildlife Conflict (HWC), the Kerala Forest & Wildlife Department launched the 'Vanavijayam' early warning network equipped with smart thermal cameras and seismic sensors that send real-time SMS alerts to villagers when wild elephant herds cross designated forest boundaries.
key_points: Project covers the vulnerable forest fringes of Mananthavady, Sulthan Bathery, and Meppadi.
Employs thermal imaging AI cameras capable of functioning in zero-visibility fog and night.
Direct integration with WhatsApp and village panchayat siren warning systems.
Project backed by the Kerala State Disaster Management Authority (KSDMA).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which district in Kerala piloted the AI-powered 'Vanavijayam' early-warning system to mitigate human-elephant conflict in forest borders?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Wayanad district was chosen as the pilot site for the 'Vanavijayam' AI wildlife corridor due to its high elephant migration density and recurring human-wildlife encounters.

title: ISRO Successfully Launches Space Docking Experiment (SPADEX) Onboard PSLV-C59
malayalam_title: ഐ.എസ്.ആർ.ഒയുടെ സ്പേസ് ഡോക്കിംഗ് പരീക്ഷണം (SPADEX) വിജയകരം
summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the SPADEX mission from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota. The mission demonstrates autonomous docking of two small satellites in orbit, a critical technology required for India’s proposed space station (Bharatiya Antariksh Station) and lunar sample return missions.
key_points: SPADEX consists of two satellites: the Chaser and the Target.
The mission was launched using the reliable PSLV-C59 rocket.
Successful docking technology makes India only the fourth nation to demonstrate space docking capabilities.
Technology is essential for the future Gaganyaan mission extensions and Chandrayaan-4.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What is the primary objective of ISRO’s SPADEX mission launched via PSLV-C59 in January 2025?

options.text: Autonomous space docking of two satellites in orbit

psc_potential_question.explanation: SPADEX (Space Docking Experiment) by ISRO successfully demonstrates the capability to rendezvous and dock two spacecraft autonomously in low-Earth orbit.

title: Kerala Government Launches K-SMART 2.0 Across All 87 Municipalities and 6 Municipal Corporations
malayalam_title: കേരളത്തിലെ എല്ലാ നഗരസഭകളിലും കെ-സ്മാർട്ട് 2.0 പദ്ധതി ആരംഭിച്ചു
summary: The Local Self Government Department of Kerala has officially rolled out K-SMART 2.0 (Kerala Solutions for Managing Administrative Reformation and Transformation) to provide 100% paperless civil services including birth/death registration, building permits, and trade licenses through an integrated digital portal.
key_points: K-SMART was developed by the Information Kerala Mission (IKM).
K-SMART 2.0 integrates AI-powered automated building plan scrutiny for permits within 24 hours.
Kerala is the first state in India to digitize all municipal services on a unified ERP platform.
Civil registrations can now be availed from anywhere in the world by non-resident Keralites (Pravasis).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which digital platform was developed by Information Kerala Mission (IKM) to provide unified paperless civil services across all municipal corporations and municipalities in Kerala?
psc_potential_question.explanation: K-SMART (Kerala Solutions for Managing Administrative Reformation and Transformation) was developed by the Information Kerala Mission to bring all urban local body services under a single web and mobile application.
